decisions.rationale: It preserves the distinct lifecycle rules for immediate read-only exploration and safeguards before destructive commands, with only modest added length.

It accurately retains the read-only exception and destructive-command safety procedure. The first alternative incorrectly treats the later change as revoking command matching and the read-only exception rather than only the generic command-order preference.

limitations: Neither learning-state alternative records the still-active requirement to match commands to the actual shell and environment or precisely identifies the revoked generic command-order preference.
